description: Globals whose start offset no code references directly (low array bounds folded into displacements), with their per-episode offsets as proven by accepted routines. tools/harness.extra_offset reads this before inferring from neighbours.

d_0000.evidence: Genus PCX Toolkit identity record (u5 typed constant, referenced by obj_u5 as offset d_0000+1Ah); SAM2/3 insert a 14-byte adapter table before it

d_001a.evidence: obj_u5 (Genus PCX toolkit) typed constant; SAM2/3 typed constants start 0Eh later

d_0296.evidence: u1_65d9: 40x25 map of 8-byte cells, displacements 01C6..01CD (sam1) / 01EC.. (sam2, sam3)

d_sam2_0000.evidence: SAM2/3-only adapter classification table used by p_sam2_107a
